subject: Mutual action plan — security gating & DPA retention clarifications
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie@finsecure.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan — security gating & DPA retention clarifications

Hi Natalie,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Per our conversation I attached an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the commercial/technical milestones and the security/compliance checkpoints we expect for a Q4 close. A few items I want to highlight up front: 

- SOC 2: we can provide our Type II report artifacts and a controls mapping; successful completion of the acceptance checklist depends on a review window we estimate at 7 business days.
- SIG/CAIQ: we've completed the CAIQ questionnaire and will share the spreadsheet; security team review typically takes ~3 business days with follow-up clarifications.
- DPA & retention: we propose standard DPA redlines (attached). The data retention window options we support are 30/90/365 days for intermediate caches; archival retention is configurable — please indicate your requirement.

Attached: FinSecure_SIG_Questions.xlsx (CAIQ export), DPA_proposed_redlines_20260920.pdf

Would you be able to confirm: the internal security reviewers and procurement gatekeepers we should expect, and a target date for the DPA redline exchange? Once we have that, we will lock the MAP dates and build the acceptance checklist with owners.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Natalie Park <natalie@finsecure.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>, Trevor Mills <trevor.mills@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — security gating & DPA retention clarifications

Thanks, Sean — this is helpful. Quick answers and clarifying Qs: 

1) Reviewers: Alice Chen (external audit coordinator) and our internal infra security team (cc'd procurement will route access).
2) SOC 2 artifacts: can you provide the control narrative and a sampling list for the last 12 months? Our audit team will need that to triage the gap assessment.
3) CAIQ: we'll upload the attached CAIQ to our tracker — expect comments.
4) DPA: procurement wants the retention window limited to 90 days for production inference logs, with a 7-year audit log archival option. Is that feasible? Also, we have a couple of DPA redlines that require legal review. See attached: FinSecure_SIG_Questions.xlsx (annotated).

We are targeting an internal go/no-go on the security gates by Oct 1. Can Redwood commit to turnaround times for each artifact set?

-Natalie
Natalie Park
Head of Security Operations, FinSecure
Natalie.Park@finsecure.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie@finsecure.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — security gating & DPA retention clarifications

Hi Natalie — following up with specifics from our side. Apologies for the slightly longer note, wanted to be explicit about owners and SLAs: 

- SOC 2 artifacts: we will provide the Type II report PDF, control narratives for the listed control families, and a sampling list within 48 hours of your confirmation. Owner: Laura Bennett (Security Partnerships).
- CAIQ/ SIG responses: we will load the CAIQ spreadsheet responses and flag any answers that are mitigations vs. direct controls. Owner: Karthik Iyer (Security Engineering). Target turnaround: 72 hours for first pass.
- DPA & retention: Redwood supports configurable retention for inference logs. Default options: 30/90/365 days. We can also enable a long-term archival export to your S3 for 7 years, but Redwood-managed archival storage beyond 1 year requires a contractual addendum (costed). Owner: Legal + Sean for procurement.
- Acceptance checklist: we'll add explicit acceptance criteria for each gate (SOC 2 docs reviewed, CAIQ clarifications closed, signed DPA with retention field set). We will include a two-business-day SLA for clarifying questions after artifact submission.

Attached: SOC2-evidence-list.csv (control-to-evidence mapping).

If procurement needs DPA redline comments, we can take a single consolidated redline and provide a response within 3 business days. For your Oct 1 go/no-go target, Sean and I propose the following compressed timeline: artifacts delivered by Sep 22, initial review comments by Sep 25, redline cycle closed by Sep 28, final signoff Oct 1. Does that align with your internal calendar?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie@finsecure.com>, Trevor Mills <trevor.mills@finsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — security gating & DPA retention clarifications

Laura / Sean — thanks for the clear owners. A couple of practical procurement asks: 

- Please confirm the contract billing contact and the legal lead for the DPA negotiation; procurement will only accept a single redline file and a table of open items.
- On retention: FinSecure prefers the 90-day managed retention for inference logs and will take an archival export to our S3 for long-term retention. We will not take Redwood-managed archival storage without a cost addendum.
- Additionally, we need a short note confirming that inference request payloads are encrypted in transit and at rest with customer-managed keys (if needed). Can Karthik or Laura provide the precise KMS/HSM integrations supported?

Attached: DPA_proposed_redlines_20260920.pdf (our annotated redline).

Procurement point: Trevor Mills (cc).

Regards,
Procurement Team
FinSecure
procurement@finsecure.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Hi all — quick status and next actions to keep us aligned for the Oct 1 go/no-go: 

- Artifacts: Laura uploaded SOC 2 PDF, control narratives, and the evidence spreadsheet to the shared drive this morning (link above). Karthik will send a short KMS/HSM support note by EOD tomorrow (Sep 30).
- DPA redlines: we received your annotated PDF (thanks). Redwood legal will produce a consolidated response doc by Sep 30 and propose a single redline file for procurement to review.
- Retention: Redwood confirms managed 90-day inference log retention is supported; we will deliver an archival export to your S3 (as requested) and will not enable Redwood-managed archival beyond 1 year without a signed addendum.
- Acceptance checklist: I've attached an updated MAP with dates/resources (minor edits). Next meeting: Sep 30 09:00 PT (30m) to run through final open items. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments referenced: FinSecure_SIG_Questions.xlsx (latest), DPA_proposed_redlines_20260920.pdf (response pending), SOC2-evidence-list.csv

If anything is missing for the Oct 1 decision, flag it now — otherwise we will proceed with the Sep 30 walkthrough.

Best,
Sean
